findings.current: *Exactly. So why did you call me into this madhouse?*
findings.defect: The mildly disrespectful vocative 이 양반아 is omitted, weakening Taekyung’s irritated familiarity with Jin Wikyung.
findings.rationale: The source ends the complaint by directly addressing Jin Wikyung with a familiar, exasperated expression.
findings.replacement: *You said it. So why did you call me into this madhouse, man?*

findings.current: Fuming, I glared at the White Tiger Hall Leader as he sat down, then noticed something strange.
findings.defect: The source describes Taekyung audibly huffing with anger; “Fuming” replaces that physical action with an abstract emotional state.
findings.rationale: 씨근덕거리며 denotes angry, heavy breathing and is a concrete action in the scene.
findings.replacement: Huffing, I glared at the White Tiger Hall Leader as he sat down, then noticed something strange.

findings.current: The White Tiger Hall Leader kept stealing glances at the old men of the Elder Council.
findings.defect: “Kept stealing glances” makes the action explicitly repeated, while the source describes a single sidelong glance.
findings.rationale: 흘끗 시선을 보내는 identifies one quick glance and contains no habitual or iterative marker.
findings.replacement: The White Tiger Hall Leader darted a glance at the old men of the Elder Council.

findings.current: Nearly half the people in attendance were acting this way. It was getting difficult to pretend I hadn’t noticed.
findings.defect: The translation preserves how obvious the faction was but drops Taekyung’s sarcastic claim that he would feel bad pretending not to notice.
findings.rationale: 모른 척하기가 미안할 지경이었다 frames the recognition as a mock concern for the conspirators, supplying the source’s deadpan joke.
findings.replacement: They made up nearly half the people in attendance. I’d have felt bad pretending not to notice.

summary: Faithful overall, with four minor losses involving register, physical action, action frequency, and sarcastic joke logic.
